content: Project deadline for the LLM lab (CS3235 Lab 6) is Friday 25 Sept, submit GitHub URL + screenshots on the course portal.
Meeting with Prof. Rao on Tuesday 4 PM in Lab 3: discuss mini-project topic (RAG over lecture notes) and bring the literature survey draft.
Groceries: milk, eggs, bread, bananas, Maggi, coffee powder, and dish soap. Pick up from the campus store before 9 PM.
Book recommendation from Ananya: 'Designing Machine Learning Systems' by Chip Huyen - good for understanding ML deployment and data pipelines.
